acceptanceCriteria: A failed Darwin exit observation sends no group signal and reports cleanup unproved, matching the V1-1047 Linux behavior.
A negative-control test fails on the current behavior and passes after; timeout/cancel and live-residue paths still clean up.
body: Suspected, found during the V1-1047 review fix (2026-10-09) by source reading at batch P head 1a9c4b3d (PR #704). In internal/dashboard/repository/process_wait_darwin.go, observationFailed (waitid returned a non-EINTR errno such as ECHILD) sets cleanupRequired, which runs stopAndProveDarwin, a group signal, while the child's state is unknown. V1-1047 fixed the same shape on Linux (process_wait_linux.go) and in the terminal harness: there, a failed observation sends no group signal and marks cleanup unproved. Expected: same on Darwin. Actual: group signals are sent. Not reproduced on a live host.
